concepts.name: base-spore-mushroom-v1.png
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original static base-species character illustration for the 2D fantasy colony strategy game Spawner. The attached sprout-bean image is a STYLE AND FACE reference only; design an entirely NEW species, not a modified bean and not a head accessory on a bean. Match its smooth antialiased hand-painted 2D rendering, slender continuous dark deep-teal contours, restrained broad soft shading, matte organic materials, calm innocent personality, tiny dark nearly round eyes with one subdued small colored glint each. No mouth, nose, cheeks, eyebrows, arms or hands. Unupgraded starter unit anatomy with no equipment, weapons, clothing, decorations, evolution attachments, magic effects or background. Extremely simple readable silhouette even as a tiny RTS unit. Front-facing, neutral pose, symmetrical facial placement, full anatomy visible. Center one character on a square 1024x1024 canvas with around 12% clear margin, character total height about 76% of canvas. True transparent RGBA background. One standalone original source artwork, no concept sheet, no other poses, no text, no labels, no swatches, no border, no watermark, no ground shadow. NO pixel art, NO 3D render, NO plastic toy, NO glossy glass, no detailed texture or excessive highlights. NEW SPECIES: a tiny blue-lilac mushroom person. The whole anatomical silhouette is a wide low umbrella above a short thick ivory stalk; do not put a mushroom hat on a round creature. One simple softly domed dusky periwinkle mushroom cap, width around 1.55 times total creature height, with one continuous gently bowed rim and a muted dark lavender underside. Cap roughly upper half of total height. Lower half is a short plump pale-cream stalk with two tiny rounded stub feet. Place two small deep-teal round eyes on the stalk below the overhanging cap, the face stays clearly visible. The organic cap grows continuously from stalk. Broad cap overhang must be the defining silhouette. Limit cap to 2-3 broad muted lavender/periwinkle shading regions and one subtle soft pale upper-left highlight, no spots, no intricate gills, no glow. No leaves, sprouts, golden food-mushroom color, soil or secondary mushrooms. Make this a calm fellow forest tribe, no threatening features.
